'''Taraja Cuttsmay''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who served as a seer for her [[Pnakotic Coast village|home village]] on the [[planet]] [[Savareen]] and provided them with blessing. Her [[tongue]] was cut out by the [[Crimson Dawn]] syndicate when she and the other villages stood up to them. In [[10 BBY]], she was present when the [[Cloud-Riders]] and a group of criminals formally affiliated with Crimson Dawn joined together with the villages to oppose the syndicate.

==Biography==
Taraja Cuttsmay was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who lived in a [[Pnakotic Coast village|village]] constructed in the ruins of the [[Bis Refinery]] on the [[Pnakotic Coast]] of his [[homeworld]] [[Savareen]].<ref name="SoloOG" /> Like the other inhabitants of the village, she had had her [[tongue]] cut out by the [[Crimson Dawn]] syndicate after the villagers stood up to the criminals and refused to pay tribute.<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> Believed to have the "[[eye]] beyond the waves" she served as a seer for the village and blessed new relationships and newborns to ensure good fortune.<ref name="SoloOG" />

In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events on [[Savareen]] in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' to nine years after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the formation of the Empire to [[19 BBY]], therefore the event on Savareen in ''Solo'' must take place in [[10 BBY]].</ref> she was present in the village when a group of Crimson Dawn affiliates led by the criminal [[Tobias Beckett]] landed in order to process [[coaxium]] they had stolen from the planet [[Kessel]]. She then witnessed the stand-off between the criminals and the [[Cloud-Riders]] gang and aided the two groups when they worked together to defeat the forces of the Crimson Dawn when they arrived on Savareen to collect the coaxium.<ref name="Solo" />

==Personality and traits==
Taraja Cuttsmay had tan skin and black hair and eyes. She was believed to have fortune-telling abilities and only showed her [[mouth]] when making predictions due to a superstition.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Equipment==
Cuttsmay wore orange [[Clothing|robes]] with a black and yellow trim.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Taraja Cuttsmay first appeared in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Solo" /> and was first named in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloOG" />
